Resolve an identification photo and description for a predator

Source: R/dv_cards.R
dv_species_card_assets.Rd

Builds the photo, description and credit line of one predator card in the dashboard (dv_build_html()). It handles one predator at a time, and the card carries no taxonomic lineage. Looks for a photo in this priority order:

  1. an explicit local path in info$photo

  2. a local file in image_dir named after the predator

  3. a local file in image_dir named after the Latin name

  4. the online sources named in photo_source, tried in the order given until one returns a photo:

    • "inaturalist": a photo of the taxon on iNaturalist (the taxon's default photo, else the first of its other photos) whose license is in licenses

    • "wikipedia": a Wikimedia Commons file declared in info$commons_file, else the Wikipedia thumbnail for the Latin name (or predator name), used only when it is a Wikimedia Commons file

Usage

dv_species_card_assets(
  predator,
  latin = NA,
  info = NULL,
  image_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "dietview-images"),
  photo_source = "none",
  licenses = c("cc0", "cc-by", "cc-by-sa"),
  use_wiki = NULL
)

Arguments

predator

Common name (used for the local file name and alt text).

latin

Latin name (used for the online lookups).

info

Optional list for this predator, with any of photo, desc, credit, author, license, url and commons_file.

image_dir

Folder holding/caching images. Defaults to a folder in tempdir(); give a permanent folder to keep downloads between sessions.

photo_source

Where to look online when no local file is found: "none" (default: no network access), or one or more of "inaturalist" and "wikipedia" (Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons), tried in that order, e.g. c("inaturalist", "wikipedia"). Each request times out after getOption("DietView.timeout", 15) seconds.

licenses

iNaturalist license codes accepted for a photo. The default keeps the licenses that allow redistribution with attribution: "cc0", "cc-by" and "cc-by-sa". Add "cc-by-nc" (and "cc-by-nc-sa", "cc-by-nd", "cc-by-nc-nd") only if the dashboard will be shared for non-commercial use and the license terms suit you.

use_wiki

Deprecated. TRUE means photo_source = "wikipedia", FALSE means photo_source = "none".

Value

A list with uri (data URI or NULL), path (the image file, or NULL), desc, desc_credit (credit for the description text), credit (photo credit line, e.g. "Photo: Jane Doe, CC BY, via iNaturalist"), author, license, source ("local", "inaturalist" or "wikimedia") and url (the photo page); each element is NULL when unknown.

Details

Every photo fetched online carries its author and license. An iNaturalist photo whose license is not in licenses (including "all rights reserved") is never used. A Commons image is kept only when Commons reports its license, and Wikipedia thumbnails hosted outside Commons, which may be non-free files, are never used.

Downloads are cached in image_dir, each with a small .json file holding its source, author, license and page URL, so a cached photo keeps its credit line in later sessions. A local photo can carry the same fields: put them in info (credit, author, license, url) or in a .json file of the same name next to the image. Delete the image and its .json file to fetch it again.

Description priority:

  1. info$desc

  2. the Wikipedia summary, as returned by iNaturalist or by Wikipedia (text under CC BY-SA, credited in desc_credit)

  3. the Wikimedia Commons image description (with photo_source = "wikipedia")

With photo_source = "none" (the default) nothing is fetched: with no local file, the result has no image and only the description given in info.

Returns a base64 data URI so the dashboard stays self-contained.

Examples

# offline: no photo resolved, returns a text-only card structure
dv_species_card_assets("Atlantic cod", image_dir = tempdir())
#> $uri
#> NULL
#> 
#> $path
#> NULL
#> 
#> $desc
#> NULL
#> 
#> $desc_credit
#> NULL
#> 
#> $credit
#> NULL
#> 
#> $author
#> NULL
#> 
#> $license
#> NULL
#> 
#> $source
#> NULL
#> 
#> $url
#> NULL
#> 
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# online: an openly licensed iNaturalist photo, with author and license
a <- dv_species_card_assets("Atlantic cod", latin = "Gadus morhua",
                            photo_source = "inaturalist",
                            image_dir = tempdir())
a$credit
} # }
